headline.purpose: Sets-won score in the set row.

title.purpose: App title, team names, panel and dialog titles.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Every top-level block; never nested boxes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Most frequent action in a group (+1, Annulla, Salva).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; background: #2563eb; border-color: rgba(37,99,235,0.55); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: rgba(15,23,42,0.24); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #0f172a; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(15,23,42,0.24); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(220,38,38,0.12); border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.35); color: #0f172a; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.55); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); background: #f9fafb; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: rgba(15,23,42,0.65); } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-weight: 400; color: #0f172a; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); background: #fff; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Score Panel
components.description: Signature: team name, serve badge, timeouts and the poster-size score.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; width: 320px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.25); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); color: #0f172a; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 22px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.14); background: #f9fafb; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(15,23,42,0.65); } .ds-points { text-align: center; font-size: 140px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }

narrative.northStar: Il Tabellone di Palestra (The Gym Scoreboard)
narrative.overview: The interface behaves like the electronic scoreboard on a gym wall: the two point totals dominate the screen and everything else exists to serve them. The look is clean and functional, and it is the style to keep.
keyCharacteristics: Score numerals at poster size (up to 280px × scale), weight 900, tabular figures.
White panels on light grey, hairline borders, one ambient shadow.
One accent colour (blue) for actions and sets won; red and green reserved for meaning.
Heavy, legible weights (700–900) throughout; nothing thin.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only colour for actions and progress. Red and green are signals with exactly one job each; never use them decoratively.

rules.name: The Tint, Don't Paint Rule
rules.body: Team identity is carried by a faint border tint (blue home, red away), never by filling panels with colour. The numerals stay ink on white.

rules.name: The Numerals First Rule
rules.body: Nothing on screen may compete with the display numerals in size or weight. A new element that needs to be large is a sign it belongs elsewhere.

rules.name: The Fluid × Scale Rule
rules.body: Every font size is a clamp() multiplied by --tv-scale. Never ship a fixed pixel font size.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Home is always left, away always right, in every row: set dots, panels and controls. Keyboard shortcuts follow the same sides (Q/A left, P/L right).

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one shadow. Depth beyond that comes from the grey inset fill, never from a second, stronger shadow.

dos: Do multiply every new size (type, padding, radius where it matters) by --tv-scale.
Do keep home left / away right in any new element.
Do keep long team names to one or two lines with ellipsis and the full name in a tooltip.
Do give every icon-only control an aria-label.
Do keep everything on one screen from 720p up: if a change adds height, take it from somewhere else.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour or use red/green outside their single meaning.
Don't fill team panels with team colours; tint the border only.
Don't add a second shadow or shadows on nested boxes.
Don't use light or thin font weights, or fixed pixel font sizes.
Don't load web fonts or any other network asset: the app must work offline.
